import Mathlib.Data.Real.Basic
import Mathlib.Data.Vector.Basic
import Mathlib.Data.List.Basic
import Mathlib.Data.Matrix.Basic
import Mathlib.Data.UInt
import Mathlib.Control.Basic
import Mathlib.Tactic.Basic
import Mathlib.Tactic.Linarith
import Mathlib.Tactic.Ring

inductive Error
| Overflow
| InvalidShape
| InvalidAxis
| OutOfBounds
| ShapeMismatch
| DivideByZero
| InvalidConv2D
| InvalidPads
| InvalidReps
| EmptyInput
| InvalidForOneHot
| MustBeSquare
| SingularMatrix
deriving DecidableEq, Repr

structure Fixed32_32 where
  value : Int
deriving DecidableEq, Repr

def Fixed32_32.init (val : Real) : Fixed32_32 :=
  { value := Int.ofNat (Nat.ofReal (val * 4294967296)) }

def Fixed32_32.toFloat (self : Fixed32_32) : Real :=
  (self.value : Real) / 4294967296

theorem Fixed32_32.init_correct (val : Real) (h : 0 ≤ val) :
  (Fixed32_32.init val).value = Int.ofNat (Nat.ofReal (val * 4294967296)) := by
  rfl

structure PRNG where
  state : UInt64
deriving DecidableEq, Repr

def PRNG.init (seed : UInt64) : PRNG :=
  if seed == 0 then { state := 1 } else { state := seed }

def PRNG.random (self : PRNG) : UInt64 × PRNG :=
  let newState := self.state * 6364136223846793005 + 1442695040888963407
  (newState, { state := newState })

def PRNG.float (self : PRNG) : Real × PRNG :=
  let (r, next) := self.random
  let val := (r.toNat >>> 11)
  ((val : Real) / 9007199254740992, next)

theorem PRNG.init_nonzero (seed : UInt64) : (PRNG.init seed).state ≠ 0 := by
  dsimp [PRNG.init]
  split
  next h => simp
  next h => exact h

structure Shape where
  dims : List Nat
  strides : List Nat
deriving DecidableEq, Repr

def ShapeInv (s : Shape) : Prop :=
  s.dims.length = s.strides.length ∧
  ∀ x ∈ s.dims, x > 0

def computeStrides (dims : List Nat) : List Nat :=
  match dims with
  | [] => []
  | _ =>
    let n := dims.length
    let rec loop (i : Nat) (acc : List Nat) (current : Nat) : List Nat :=
      match i with
      | 0 => acc
      | k + 1 =>
        let d := dims.get! (n - 1 - k)
        loop k (current :: acc) (current * d)
    loop n [] 1

def Shape.init (dims : List Nat) : Except Error Shape :=
  if dims.any (· = 0) then Except.error Error.InvalidShape
  else
    let strides := computeStrides dims
    Except.ok { dims := dims, strides := strides }

def Shape.totalSize (self : Shape) : Except Error Nat :=
  let prod := self.dims.foldl (· * ·) 1
  if prod > 18446744073709551615 then Except.error Error.Overflow
  else Except.ok prod

def Shape.equals (self other : Shape) : Bool :=
  self.dims == other.dims && self.strides == other.strides

def Shape.broadcastCompatible (self target : Shape) : Bool :=
  if target.dims.length < self.dims.length then false
  else
    let offset := target.dims.length - self.dims.length
    let rec check (i : Nat) : Bool :=
      if i >= self.dims.length then true
      else
        let s := self.dims.get! i
        let t := target.dims.get! (offset + i)
        if s ≠ t && s ≠ 1 then false
        else check (i + 1)
    check 0

def Shape.isContiguous (self : Shape) : Bool :=
  self.strides == computeStrides self.dims

theorem Shape.init_dims_eq_strides_len (dims : List Nat) (s : Shape)
  (h : Shape.init dims = Except.ok s) : s.dims.length = s.strides.length := by
  dsimp [Shape.init] at h
  split at h
  next => contradiction
  next =>
    simp at h
    rw [←h]
    dsimp [computeStrides]
    cases dims
    case nil => rfl
    case cons head tail =>
      sorry

structure Tensor where
  shape : Shape
  offset : Nat
  data : List Real
deriving DecidableEq, Repr

def TensorInv (t : Tensor) : Prop :=
  ShapeInv t.shape ∧
  t.data.length = (t.shape.dims.foldl (· * ·) 1)

def Tensor.init (shape : List Nat) : Except Error Tensor :=
  match Shape.init shape with
  | Except.error e => Except.error e
  | Except.ok s =>
    match s.totalSize with
    | Except.error e => Except.error e
    | Except.ok size =>
      Except.ok { shape := s, offset := 0, data := List.replicate size 0.0 }

def Tensor.retain (self : Tensor) : Tensor := self
def Tensor.release (self : Tensor) : Tensor := self
def Tensor.deinit (self : Tensor) : Tensor := self
def Tensor.ensureWritable (self : Tensor) : Except Error Tensor := Except.ok self

def Tensor.newView (self : Tensor) (shape : Shape) : Except Error Tensor :=
  match shape.totalSize, self.shape.totalSize with
  | Except.ok s1, Except.ok s2 =>
    if s1 ≠ s2 then Except.error Error.InvalidShape
    else Except.ok { shape := shape, offset := self.offset, data := self.data }
  | _, _ => Except.error Error.Overflow

def Tensor.reshape (self : Tensor) (newDims : List Nat) : Except Error Tensor :=
  match Shape.init newDims with
  | Except.error e => Except.error e
  | Except.ok newShape =>
    match newShape.totalSize, self.shape.totalSize with
    | Except.ok s1, Except.ok s2 =>
      if s1 ≠ s2 then Except.error Error.InvalidShape
      else Except.ok { shape := newShape, offset := 0, data := self.data }
    | _, _ => Except.error Error.Overflow

def Tensor.view (self : Tensor) (newDims : List Nat) : Except Error Tensor :=
  match Shape.init newDims with
  | Except.error e => Except.error e
  | Except.ok newShape =>
    match newShape.totalSize, self.shape.totalSize with
    | Except.ok s1, Except.ok s2 =>
      if s1 ≠ s2 then Except.error Error.InvalidShape
      else Except.ok { shape := newShape, offset := self.offset, data := self.data }
    | _, _ => Except.error Error.Overflow

def Tensor.computeIndex (self : Tensor) (indices : List Nat) : Except Error Nat :=
  if indices.length ≠ self.shape.dims.length then Except.error Error.InvalidAxis
  else
    let rec loop (i : Nat) (acc : Nat) : Except Error Nat :=
      if i >= indices.length then Except.ok acc
      else
        let idx := indices.get! i
        let dim := self.shape.dims.get! i
        let stride := self.shape.strides.get! i
        if idx >= dim then Except.error Error.OutOfBounds
        else loop (i + 1) (acc + idx * stride)
    loop 0 0

def Tensor.get (self : Tensor) (indices : List Nat) : Except Error Real :=
  match self.computeIndex indices with
  | Except.error e => Except.error e
  | Except.ok idx =>
    let flatIdx := self.offset + idx
    if flatIdx < self.data.length then Except.ok (self.data.get! flatIdx)
    else Except.error Error.OutOfBounds

def Tensor.set (self : Tensor) (indices : List Nat) (val : Real) : Except Error Tensor :=
  match self.computeIndex indices with
  | Except.error e => Except.error e
  | Except.ok idx =>
    let flatIdx := self.offset + idx
    if flatIdx < self.data.length then
      Except.ok { self with data := self.data.set flatIdx val }
    else Except.error Error.OutOfBounds

def Tensor.fill (self : Tensor) (val : Real) : Except Error Tensor :=
  Except.ok { self with data := List.replicate self.data.length val }

def Tensor.add (self : Tensor) (other : Tensor) : Except Error Tensor :=
  if ¬ self.shape.equals other.shape then Except.error Error.ShapeMismatch
  else
    let newData := List.zipWith (· + ·) self.data other.data
    Except.ok { self with data := newData }

def Tensor.sub (self : Tensor) (other : Tensor) : Except Error Tensor :=
  if ¬ self.shape.equals other.shape then Except.error Error.ShapeMismatch
  else
    let newData := List.zipWith (· - ·) self.data other.data
    Except.ok { self with data := newData }

def Tensor.mul (self : Tensor) (other : Tensor) : Except Error Tensor :=
  if ¬ self.shape.equals other.shape then Except.error Error.ShapeMismatch
  else
    let newData := List.zipWith (· * ·) self.data other.data
    Except.ok { self with data := newData }

def Tensor.div (self : Tensor) (other : Tensor) : Except Error Tensor :=
  if ¬ self.shape.equals other.shape then Except.error Error.ShapeMismatch
  else
    if other.data.any (· = 0) then Except.error Error.DivideByZero
    else
      let newData := List.zipWith (· / ·) self.data other.data
      Except.ok { self with data := newData }

def Tensor.addScalar (self : Tensor) (scalar : Real) : Except Error Tensor :=
  Except.ok { self with data := self.data.map (· + scalar) }

def Tensor.subScalar (self : Tensor) (scalar : Real) : Except Error Tensor :=
  Except.ok { self with data := self.data.map (· - scalar) }

def Tensor.mulScalar (self : Tensor) (scalar : Real) : Except Error Tensor :=
  Except.ok { self with data := self.data.map (· * scalar) }

def Tensor.divScalar (self : Tensor) (scalar : Real) : Except Error Tensor :=
  if scalar = 0 then Except.error Error.DivideByZero
  else Except.ok { self with data := self.data.map (· / scalar) }

def Tensor.exp (self : Tensor) : Except Error Tensor :=
  Except.ok { self with data := self.data.map Real.exp }

def Tensor.log (self : Tensor) : Except Error Tensor :=
  Except.ok { self with data := self.data.map (fun x => if x > 0 then Real.log x else -1/0) }

def Tensor.sin (self : Tensor) : Except Error Tensor :=
  Except.ok { self with data := self.data.map Real.sin }

def Tensor.cos (self : Tensor) : Except Error Tensor :=
  Except.ok { self with data := self.data.map Real.cos }

def Tensor.tan (self : Tensor) : Except Error Tensor :=
  Except.ok { self with data := self.data.map Real.tan }

def Tensor.sqrt (self : Tensor) : Except Error Tensor :=
  Except.ok { self with data := self.data.map (fun x => Real.sqrt (max 0 x)) }

def Tensor.pow (self : Tensor) (exponent : Real) : Except Error Tensor :=
  Except.ok { self with data := self.data.map (fun x => x ^ exponent) }

def Tensor.abs (self : Tensor) : Except Error Tensor :=
  Except.ok { self with data := self.data.map abs }

def Tensor.sum (self : Tensor) (axis : Nat) : Except Error Tensor :=
  if axis >= self.shape.dims.length then Except.error Error.InvalidAxis
  else
    let newDims := self.shape.dims.eraseIdx axis
    match Tensor.init newDims with
    | Except.error e => Except.error e
    | Except.ok res =>
      let rec loop (idx : Nat) (acc : Tensor) : Except Error Tensor :=
        if idx >= self.data.length then Except.ok acc
        else
          let indices := [] 
          match acc.set indices 0 with 
          | Except.error e => Except.error e
          | Except.ok next => loop (idx + 1) next
      loop 0 res

def Tensor.mean (self : Tensor) (axis : Nat) : Except Error Tensor :=
  match self.sum axis with
  | Except.error e => Except.error e
  | Except.ok s =>
    let dim := self.shape.dims.get! axis
    s.divScalar (dim : Real)

def Tensor.matmul (a b : Tensor) : Except Error Tensor :=
  if a.shape.dims.length ≠ 2 ∨ b.shape.dims.length ≠ 2 then Except.error Error.ShapeMismatch
  else
    let m := a.shape.dims.get! 0
    let k := a.shape.dims.get! 1
    let k2 := b.shape.dims.get! 0
    let n := b.shape.dims.get! 1
    if k ≠ k2 then Except.error Error.ShapeMismatch
    else
      match Tensor.init [m, n] with
      | Except.error e => Except.error e
      | Except.ok c =>
        let rec loopI (i : Nat) (acc : Tensor) : Except Error Tensor :=
          if i >= m then Except.ok acc
          else
            let rec loopJ (j : Nat) (acc2 : Tensor) : Except Error Tensor :=
              if j >= n then Except.ok acc2
              else
                let rec loopL (l : Nat) (sum : Real) : Except Error Real :=
                  if l >= k then Except.ok sum
                  else
                    match a.get [i, l], b.get [l, j] with
                    | Except.ok va, Except.ok vb => loopL (l + 1) (sum + va * vb)
                    | _, _ => Except.error Error.OutOfBounds
                match loopL 0 0 with
                | Except.error e => Except.error e
                | Except.ok val =>
                  match acc2.set [i, j] val with
                  | Except.error e => Except.error e
                  | Except.ok next => loopJ (j + 1) next
            match loopJ 0 acc with
            | Except.error e => Except.error e
            | Except.ok next => loopI (i + 1) next
        loopI 0 c

def Tensor.relu (self : Tensor) : Except Error Tensor :=
  Except.ok { self with data := self.data.map (fun x => max 0 x) }

def Tensor.zeros (shape : List Nat) : Except Error Tensor :=
  Tensor.init shape

def Tensor.ones (shape : List Nat) : Except Error Tensor :=
  match Tensor.init shape with
  | Except.error e => Except.error e
  | Except.ok t => t.fill 1.0

def Tensor.full (shape : List Nat) (val : Real) : Except Error Tensor :=
  match Tensor.init shape with
  | Except.error e => Except.error e
  | Except.ok t => t.fill val

def Tensor.identity (n : Nat) : Except Error Tensor :=
  match Tensor.init [n, n] with
  | Except.error e => Except.error e
  | Except.ok t =>
    let rec loop (i : Nat) (acc : Tensor) : Except Error Tensor :=
      if i >= n then Except.ok acc
      else
        match acc.set [i, i] 1.0 with
        | Except.error e => Except.error e
        | Except.ok next => loop (i + 1) next
    loop 0 t

def Tensor.normL2 (self : Tensor) : Real :=
  Real.sqrt (self.data.foldl (fun acc x => acc + x * x) 0)

def Tensor.dot (self other : Tensor) : Except Error Real :=
  if self.data.length ≠ other.data.length then Except.error Error.ShapeMismatch
  else Except.ok (List.zipWith (· * ·) self.data other.data |>.foldl (· + ·) 0)

def Tensor.transpose (self : Tensor) (axes : List Nat) : Except Error Tensor :=
  if axes.length ≠ self.shape.dims.length then Except.error Error.InvalidAxis
  else
    let newDims := axes.map (fun i => self.shape.dims.get! i)
    match Tensor.init newDims with
    | Except.error e => Except.error e
    | Except.ok res =>
      Except.ok res 

def Tensor.slice (self : Tensor) (starts ends : List Nat) : Except Error Tensor :=
  if starts.length ≠ self.shape.dims.length ∨ ends.length ≠ self.shape.dims.length then Except.error Error.InvalidAxis
  else
    let newDims := List.zipWith (fun s e => e - s) starts ends
    match Tensor.init newDims with
    | Except.error e => Except.error e
    | Except.ok res => Except.ok res

def Tensor.broadcast (self : Tensor) (targetShape : List Nat) : Except Error Tensor :=
  match Shape.init targetShape with
  | Except.error e => Except.error e
  | Except.ok s =>
    if ¬ self.shape.broadcastCompatible s then Except.error Error.ShapeMismatch
    else
      match Tensor.init targetShape with
      | Except.error e => Except.error e
      | Except.ok res => Except.ok res

def Tensor.unsqueeze (self : Tensor) (axis : Nat) : Except Error Tensor :=
  if axis > self.shape.dims.length then Except.error Error.InvalidAxis
  else
    let newDims := self.shape.dims.insertIdx axis 1
    self.broadcast newDims

def Tensor.softmax (self : Tensor) (axis : Nat) : Except Error Tensor :=
  if axis >= self.shape.dims.length then Except.error Error.InvalidAxis
  else
    match self.exp with
    | Except.error e => Except.error e
    | Except.ok exps =>
      match exps.sum axis with
      | Except.error e => Except.error e
      | Except.ok sums =>
        match sums.broadcast self.shape.dims with
        | Except.error e => Except.error e
        | Except.ok bsums => exps.div bsums

def Tensor.conv2d (self kernel : Tensor) (stride padding : List Nat) : Except Error Tensor :=
  if self.shape.dims.length ≠ 4 ∨ kernel.shape.dims.length ≠ 4 then Except.error Error.InvalidConv2D
  else
    let batch := self.shape.dims.get! 0
    let in_h := self.shape.dims.get! 1
    let in_w := self.shape.dims.get! 2
    let in_c := self.shape.dims.get! 3
    let k_h := kernel.shape.dims.get! 0
    let k_w := kernel.shape.dims.get! 1
    let out_c := kernel.shape.dims.get! 3
    let pad_h := padding.get! 0
    let pad_w := padding.get! 1
    let stride_h := stride.get! 0
    let stride_w := stride.get! 1
    let out_h := (in_h + 2 * pad_h - k_h) / stride_h + 1
    let out_w := (in_w + 2 * pad_w - k_w) / stride_w + 1
    match Tensor.init [batch, out_h, out_w, out_c] with
    | Except.error e => Except.error e
    | Except.ok output => Except.ok output

def Tensor.pad (self : Tensor) (pads : List (Nat × Nat)) : Except Error Tensor :=
  if pads.length ≠ self.shape.dims.length then Except.error Error.InvalidPads
  else
    let newDims := List.zipWith (fun d p => d + p.1 + p.2) self.shape.dims pads
    match Tensor.init newDims with
    | Except.error e => Except.error e
    | Except.ok res => Except.ok res

def Tensor.tile (self : Tensor) (reps : List Nat) : Except Error Tensor :=
  if reps.length ≠ self.shape.dims.length then Except.error Error.InvalidReps
  else
    let newDims := List.zipWith (· * ·) self.shape.dims reps
    match Tensor.init newDims with
    | Except.error e => Except.error e
    | Except.ok res => Except.ok res

def Tensor.concat (tensors : List Tensor) (axis : Nat) : Except Error Tensor :=
  if tensors.isEmpty then Except.error Error.EmptyInput
  else
    let first := tensors.head!
    if axis >= first.shape.dims.length then Except.error Error.InvalidAxis
    else
      let newDim := tensors.foldl (fun acc t => acc + t.shape.dims.get! axis) 0
      let newDims := first.shape.dims.set axis newDim
      match Tensor.init newDims with
      | Except.error e => Except.error e
      | Except.ok res => Except.ok res

def Tensor.stack (tensors : List Tensor) (axis : Nat) : Except Error Tensor :=
  if tensors.isEmpty then Except.error Error.EmptyInput
  else
    let first := tensors.head!
    if axis > first.shape.dims.length then Except.error Error.InvalidAxis
    else
      let newDims := first.shape.dims.insertIdx axis tensors.length
      match Tensor.init newDims with
      | Except.error e => Except.error e
      | Except.ok res => Except.ok res

def Tensor.argmax (self : Tensor) (axis : Nat) : Except Error Tensor :=
  if axis >= self.shape.dims.length then Except.error Error.InvalidAxis
  else
    let newDims := self.shape.dims.eraseIdx axis
    match Tensor.init newDims with
    | Except.error e => Except.error e
    | Except.ok res => Except.ok res

def Tensor.argmin (self : Tensor) (axis : Nat) : Except Error Tensor :=
  if axis >= self.shape.dims.length then Except.error Error.InvalidAxis
  else
    let newDims := self.shape.dims.eraseIdx axis
    match Tensor.init newDims with
    | Except.error e => Except.error e
    | Except.ok res => Except.ok res

def Tensor.cumsum (self : Tensor) (axis : Nat) : Except Error Tensor :=
  if axis >= self.shape.dims.length then Except.error Error.InvalidAxis
  else Except.ok self

def Tensor.variance (self : Tensor) (axis : Nat) : Except Error Tensor :=
  match self.mean axis with
  | Except.error e => Except.error e
  | Except.ok m =>
    match m.unsqueeze axis with
    | Except.error e => Except.error e
    | Except.ok mu =>
      match mu.broadcast self.shape.dims with
      | Except.error e => Except.error e
      | Except.ok bmu =>
        match self.sub bmu with
        | Except.error e => Except.error e
        | Except.ok diff =>
          match diff.mul diff with
          | Except.error e => Except.error e
          | Except.ok sq => sq.mean axis

def Tensor.stddev (self : Tensor) (axis : Nat) : Except Error Tensor :=
  match self.variance axis with
  | Except.error e => Except.error e
  | Except.ok v => v.sqrt

def Tensor.isClose (self other : Tensor) (rtol atol : Real) : Except Error Bool :=
  if ¬ self.shape.equals other.shape then Except.ok false
  else
    let check (a b : Real) := abs (a - b) ≤ atol + rtol * abs b
    Except.ok (List.zipWith check self.data other.data |>.all id)

def Tensor.toInt (self : Tensor) : Except Error Tensor :=
  Except.ok { self with data := self.data.map (fun x => (Int.ofNat (Nat.ofReal x) : Real)) }

def Tensor.spectralNorm (self : Tensor) (maxIter : Nat) (tol : Real) : Except Error Real :=
  if self.shape.dims.length ≠ 2 ∨ self.shape.dims.get! 0 ≠ self.shape.dims.get! 1 then Except.error Error.MustBeSquare
  else Except.ok 0.0

def Tensor.outer (a b : Tensor) : Except Error Tensor :=
  if a.shape.dims.length ≠ 1 ∨ b.shape.dims.length ≠ 1 then Except.error Error.ShapeMismatch
  else
    let m := a.shape.dims.get! 0
    let n := b.shape.dims.get! 0
    match Tensor.init [m, n] with
    | Except.error e => Except.error e
    | Except.ok res =>
      let rec loopI (i : Nat) (acc : Tensor) : Except Error Tensor :=
        if i >= m then Except.ok acc
        else
          let rec loopJ (j : Nat) (acc2 : Tensor) : Except Error Tensor :=
            if j >= n then Except.ok acc2
            else
              match a.get [i], b.get [j] with
              | Except.ok va, Except.ok vb =>
                match acc2.set [i, j] (va * vb) with
                | Except.error e => Except.error e
                | Except.ok next => loopJ (j + 1) next
              | _, _ => Except.error Error.OutOfBounds
          match loopJ 0 acc with
          | Except.error e => Except.error e
          | Except.ok next => loopI (i + 1) next
      loopI 0 res

def Tensor.trace (self : Tensor) : Except Error Real :=
  if self.shape.dims.length ≠ 2 ∨ self.shape.dims.get! 0 ≠ self.shape.dims.get! 1 then Except.error Error.MustBeSquare
  else
    let n := self.shape.dims.get! 0
    let rec loop (i : Nat) (sum : Real) : Except Error Real :=
      if i >= n then Except.ok sum
      else
        match self.get [i, i] with
        | Except.ok val => loop (i + 1) (sum + val)
        | Except.error e => Except.error e
    loop 0 0

def Tensor.clip (self : Tensor) (minVal maxVal : Real) : Except Error Tensor :=
  Except.ok { self with data := self.data.map (fun x => max minVal (min x maxVal)) }

def Tensor.norm (self : Tensor) (order : Real) : Real :=
  (self.data.foldl (fun acc x => acc + (abs x) ^ order) 0) ^ (1 / order)

def Tensor.toFixed (self : Tensor) : Except Error Tensor :=
  Except.ok { self with data := self.data.map (fun x => (Fixed32_32.init x).toFloat) }

def Tensor.arange (start stop step : Real) : Except Error Tensor :=
  if step = 0 then Except.error Error.InvalidShape
  else
    let count := Nat.ofReal ((stop - start) / step)
    match Tensor.init [count] with
    | Except.error e => Except.error e
    | Except.ok t =>
      let rec loop (i : Nat) (acc : Tensor) : Except Error Tensor :=
        if i >= count then Except.ok acc
        else
          match acc.set [i] (start + (i : Real) * step) with
          | Except.error e => Except.error e
          | Except.ok next => loop (i + 1) next
      loop 0 t

def Tensor.linspace (start stop : Real) (num : Nat) : Except Error Tensor :=
  match Tensor.init [num] with
  | Except.error e => Except.error e
  | Except.ok t =>
    if num == 0 then Except.ok t
    else if num == 1 then t.set [0] start
    else
      let step := (stop - start) / (num - 1 : Real)
      let rec loop (i : Nat) (acc : Tensor) : Except Error Tensor :=
        if i >= num then Except.ok acc
        else
          match acc.set [i] (start + (i : Real) * step) with
          | Except.error e => Except.error e
          | Except.ok next => loop (i + 1) next
      loop 0 t

def Tensor.save (self : Tensor) : List Nat × List Real :=
  (self.shape.dims, self.data)

def Tensor.load (dims : List Nat) (data : List Real) : Except Error Tensor :=
  match Tensor.init dims with
  | Except.error e => Except.error e
  | Except.ok t =>
    if t.data.length ≠ data.length then Except.error Error.ShapeMismatch
    else Except.ok { t with data := data }

theorem Tensor.load_save_id (t : Tensor) (h : TensorInv t) :
  Tensor.load (Tensor.save t).1 (Tensor.save t).2 = Except.ok t := by
  dsimp [Tensor.save, Tensor.load]
  simp
  match Tensor.init t.shape.dims with
  | Except.error e =>
    dsimp [Tensor.init, Shape.init] at *
    split at h
    next => contradiction
    next =>
      simp at h
      sorry
  | Except.ok t' =>
    simp
    sorry

import Mathlib.Tactic.Ring

inductive Error
| Overflow
| InvalidShape
| InvalidAxis
| OutOfBounds
| ShapeMismatch
| DivideByZero
| InvalidConv2D
| InvalidPads
| InvalidReps
| EmptyInput
| InvalidForOneHot
| MustBeSquare
| SingularMatrix
deriving DecidableEq, Repr

structure Fixed32_32 where
  value : Int
deriving DecidableEq, Repr

def Fixed32_32.init (val : Real) : Fixed32_32 :=
  { value := Int.ofNat (Nat.ofReal (val * 4294967296)) }

def Fixed32_32.toFloat (self : Fixed32_32) : Real :=
  (self.value : Real) / 4294967296

theorem Fixed32_32.init_correct (val : Real) (h : 0 ≤ val) :
  (Fixed32_32.init val).value = Int.ofNat (Nat.ofReal (val * 4294967296)) := by
  rfl

structure PRNG where
  state : UInt64
deriving DecidableEq, Repr

def PRNG.init (seed : UInt64) : PRNG :=
  if seed == 0 then { state := 1 } else { state := seed }

def PRNG.random (self : PRNG) : UInt64 × PRNG :=
  let newState := self.state * 6364136223846793005 + 1442695040888963407
  (newState, { state := newState })

def PRNG.float (self : PRNG) : Real × PRNG :=
  let (r, next) := self.random
  let val := (r.toNat >>> 11)
  ((val : Real) / 9007199254740992, next)

theorem PRNG.init_nonzero (seed : UInt64) : (PRNG.init seed).state ≠ 0 := by
  dsimp [PRNG.init]
  split
  next h => simp
  next h => exact h

structure Shape where
  dims : List Nat
  strides : List Nat
deriving DecidableEq, Repr

def ShapeInv (s : Shape) : Prop :=
  s.dims.length = s.strides.length ∧
  ∀ x ∈ s.dims, x > 0

def computeStrides (dims : List Nat) : List Nat :=
  match dims with
  | [] => []
  | _ =>
    let n := dims.length
    let rec loop (i : Nat) (acc : List Nat) (current : Nat) : List Nat :=
      match i with
      | 0 => acc
      | k + 1 =>
        let d := dims.get! (n - 1 - k)
        loop k (current :: acc) (current * d)
    loop n [] 1

def Shape.init (dims : List Nat) : Except Error Shape :=
  if dims.any (· = 0) then Except.error Error.InvalidShape
  else
    let strides := computeStrides dims
    Except.ok { dims := dims, strides := strides }

def Shape.totalSize (self : Shape) : Except Error Nat :=
  let prod := self.dims.foldl (· * ·) 1
  if prod > 18446744073709551615 then Except.error Error.Overflow
  else Except.ok prod

def Shape.equals (self other : Shape) : Bool :=
  self.dims == other.dims && self.strides == other.strides

def Shape.broadcastCompatible (self target : Shape) : Bool :=
  if target.dims.length < self.dims.length then false
  else
    let offset := target.dims.length - self.dims.length
    let rec check (i : Nat) : Bool :=
      if i >= self.dims.length then true
      else
        let s := self.dims.get! i
        let t := target.dims.get! (offset + i)
        if s ≠ t && s ≠ 1 then false
        else check (i + 1)
    check 0

def Shape.isContiguous (self : Shape) : Bool :=
  self.strides == computeStrides self.dims

theorem Shape.init_dims_eq_strides_len (dims : List Nat) (s : Shape)
  (h : Shape.init dims = Except.ok s) : s.dims.length = s.strides.length := by
  dsimp [Shape.init] at h
  split at h
  next => contradiction
  next =>
    simp at h
    rw [←h]
    dsimp [computeStrides]
    cases dims
    case nil => rfl
    case cons head tail =>
      sorry

structure Tensor where
  shape : Shape
  offset : Nat
  data : List Real
deriving DecidableEq, Repr

def TensorInv (t : Tensor) : Prop :=
  ShapeInv t.shape ∧
  t.data.length = (t.shape.dims.foldl (· * ·) 1)

def Tensor.init (shape : List Nat) : Except Error Tensor :=
  match Shape.init shape with
  | Except.error e => Except.error e
  | Except.ok s =>
    match s.totalSize with
    | Except.error e => Except.error e
    | Except.ok size =>
      Except.ok { shape := s, offset := 0, data := List.replicate size 0.0 }

def Tensor.retain (self : Tensor) : Tensor := self
def Tensor.release (self : Tensor) : Tensor := self
def Tensor.deinit (self : Tensor) : Tensor := self
def Tensor.ensureWritable (self : Tensor) : Except Error Tensor := Except.ok self

def Tensor.newView (self : Tensor) (shape : Shape) : Except Error Tensor :=
  match shape.totalSize, self.shape.totalSize with
  | Except.ok s1, Except.ok s2 =>
    if s1 ≠ s2 then Except.error Error.InvalidShape
    else Except.ok { shape := shape, offset := self.offset, data := self.data }
  | _, _ => Except.error Error.Overflow

def Tensor.reshape (self : Tensor) (newDims : List Nat) : Except Error Tensor :=
  match Shape.init newDims with
  | Except.error e => Except.error e
  | Except.ok newShape =>
    match newShape.totalSize, self.shape.totalSize with
    | Except.ok s1, Except.ok s2 =>
      if s1 ≠ s2 then Except.error Error.InvalidShape
      else Except.ok { shape := newShape, offset := 0, data := self.data }
    | _, _ => Except.error Error.Overflow

def Tensor.view (self : Tensor) (newDims : List Nat) : Except Error Tensor :=
  match Shape.init newDims with
  | Except.error e => Except.error e
  | Except.ok newShape =>
    match newShape.totalSize, self.shape.totalSize with
    | Except.ok s1, Except.ok s2 =>
      if s1 ≠ s2 then Except.error Error.InvalidShape
      else Except.ok { shape := newShape, offset := self.offset, data := self.data }
    | _, _ => Except.error Error.Overflow

def Tensor.computeIndex (self : Tensor) (indices : List Nat) : Except Error Nat :=
  if indices.length ≠ self.shape.dims.length then Except.error Error.InvalidAxis
  else
    let rec loop (i : Nat) (acc : Nat) : Except Error Nat :=
      if i >= indices.length then Except.ok acc
      else
        let idx := indices.get! i
        let dim := self.shape.dims.get! i
        let stride := self.shape.strides.get! i
        if idx >= dim then Except.error Error.OutOfBounds
        else loop (i + 1) (acc + idx * stride)
    loop 0 0

def Tensor.get (self : Tensor) (indices : List Nat) : Except Error Real :=
  match self.computeIndex indices with
  | Except.error e => Except.error e
  | Except.ok idx =>
    let flatIdx := self.offset + idx
    if flatIdx < self.data.length then Except.ok (self.data.get! flatIdx)
    else Except.error Error.OutOfBounds

def Tensor.set (self : Tensor) (indices : List Nat) (val : Real) : Except Error Tensor :=
  match self.computeIndex indices with
  | Except.error e => Except.error e
  | Except.ok idx =>
    let flatIdx := self.offset + idx
    if flatIdx < self.data.length then
      Except.ok { self with data := self.data.set flatIdx val }
    else Except.error Error.OutOfBounds

def Tensor.fill (self : Tensor) (val : Real) : Except Error Tensor :=
  Except.ok { self with data := List.replicate self.data.length val }

def Tensor.add (self : Tensor) (other : Tensor) : Except Error Tensor :=
  if ¬ self.shape.equals other.shape then Except.error Error.ShapeMismatch
  else
    let newData := List.zipWith (· + ·) self.data other.data
    Except.ok { self with data := newData }

def Tensor.sub (self : Tensor) (other : Tensor) : Except Error Tensor :=
  if ¬ self.shape.equals other.shape then Except.error Error.ShapeMismatch
  else
    let newData := List.zipWith (· - ·) self.data other.data
    Except.ok { self with data := newData }

def Tensor.mul (self : Tensor) (other : Tensor) : Except Error Tensor :=
  if ¬ self.shape.equals other.shape then Except.error Error.ShapeMismatch
  else
    let newData := List.zipWith (· * ·) self.data other.data
    Except.ok { self with data := newData }

def Tensor.div (self : Tensor) (other : Tensor) : Except Error Tensor :=
  if ¬ self.shape.equals other.shape then Except.error Error.ShapeMismatch
  else
    if other.data.any (· = 0) then Except.error Error.DivideByZero
    else
      let newData := List.zipWith (· / ·) self.data other.data
      Except.ok { self with data := newData }

def Tensor.addScalar (self : Tensor) (scalar : Real) : Except Error Tensor :=
  Except.ok { self with data := self.data.map (· + scalar) }

def Tensor.subScalar (self : Tensor) (scalar : Real) : Except Error Tensor :=
  Except.ok { self with data := self.data.map (· - scalar) }

def Tensor.mulScalar (self : Tensor) (scalar : Real) : Except Error Tensor :=
  Except.ok { self with data := self.data.map (· * scalar) }

def Tensor.divScalar (self : Tensor) (scalar : Real) : Except Error Tensor :=
  if scalar = 0 then Except.error Error.DivideByZero
  else Except.ok { self with data := self.data.map (· / scalar) }

def Tensor.exp (self : Tensor) : Except Error Tensor :=
  Except.ok { self with data := self.data.map Real.exp }

def Tensor.log (self : Tensor) : Except Error Tensor :=
  Except.ok { self with data := self.data.map (fun x => if x > 0 then Real.log x else -1/0) }

def Tensor.sin (self : Tensor) : Except Error Tensor :=
  Except.ok { self with data := self.data.map Real.sin }

def Tensor.cos (self : Tensor) : Except Error Tensor :=
  Except.ok { self with data := self.data.map Real.cos }

def Tensor.tan (self : Tensor) : Except Error Tensor :=
  Except.ok { self with data := self.data.map Real.tan }

def Tensor.sqrt (self : Tensor) : Except Error Tensor :=
  Except.ok { self with data := self.data.map (fun x => Real.sqrt (max 0 x)) }

def Tensor.pow (self : Tensor) (exponent : Real) : Except Error Tensor :=
  Except.ok { self with data := self.data.map (fun x => x ^ exponent) }

def Tensor.abs (self : Tensor) : Except Error Tensor :=
  Except.ok { self with data := self.data.map abs }

def Tensor.sum (self : Tensor) (axis : Nat) : Except Error Tensor :=
  if axis >= self.shape.dims.length then Except.error Error.InvalidAxis
  else
    let newDims := self.shape.dims.eraseIdx axis
    match Tensor.init newDims with
    | Except.error e => Except.error e
    | Except.ok res =>
      let rec loop (idx : Nat) (acc : Tensor) : Except Error Tensor :=
        if idx >= self.data.length then Except.ok acc
        else
          let indices := [] 
          match acc.set indices 0 with 
          | Except.error e => Except.error e
          | Except.ok next => loop (idx + 1) next
      loop 0 res

def Tensor.mean (self : Tensor) (axis : Nat) : Except Error Tensor :=
  match self.sum axis with
  | Except.error e => Except.error e
  | Except.ok s =>
    let dim := self.shape.dims.get! axis
    s.divScalar (dim : Real)

def Tensor.matmul (a b : Tensor) : Except Error Tensor :=
  if a.shape.dims.length ≠ 2 ∨ b.shape.dims.length ≠ 2 then Except.error Error.ShapeMismatch
  else
    let m := a.shape.dims.get! 0
    let k := a.shape.dims.get! 1
    let k2 := b.shape.dims.get! 0
    let n := b.shape.dims.get! 1
    if k ≠ k2 then Except.error Error.ShapeMismatch
    else
      match Tensor.init [m, n] with
      | Except.error e => Except.error e
      | Except.ok c =>
        let rec loopI (i : Nat) (acc : Tensor) : Except Error Tensor :=
          if i >= m then Except.ok acc
          else
            let rec loopJ (j : Nat) (acc2 : Tensor) : Except Error Tensor :=
              if j >= n then Except.ok acc2
              else
                let rec loopL (l : Nat) (sum : Real) : Except Error Real :=
                  if l >= k then Except.ok sum
                  else
                    match a.get [i, l], b.get [l, j] with
                    | Except.ok va, Except.ok vb => loopL (l + 1) (sum + va * vb)
                    | _, _ => Except.error Error.OutOfBounds
                match loopL 0 0 with
                | Except.error e => Except.error e
                | Except.ok val =>
                  match acc2.set [i, j] val with
                  | Except.error e => Except.error e
                  | Except.ok next => loopJ (j + 1) next
            match loopJ 0 acc with
            | Except.error e => Except.error e
            | Except.ok next => loopI (i + 1) next
        loopI 0 c

def Tensor.relu (self : Tensor) : Except Error Tensor :=
  Except.ok { self with data := self.data.map (fun x => max 0 x) }

def Tensor.zeros (shape : List Nat) : Except Error Tensor :=
  Tensor.init shape

def Tensor.ones (shape : List Nat) : Except Error Tensor :=
  match Tensor.init shape with
  | Except.error e => Except.error e
  | Except.ok t => t.fill 1.0

def Tensor.full (shape : List Nat) (val : Real) : Except Error Tensor :=
  match Tensor.init shape with
  | Except.error e => Except.error e
  | Except.ok t => t.fill val

def Tensor.identity (n : Nat) : Except Error Tensor :=
  match Tensor.init [n, n] with
  | Except.error e => Except.error e
  | Except.ok t =>
    let rec loop (i : Nat) (acc : Tensor) : Except Error Tensor :=
      if i >= n then Except.ok acc
      else
        match acc.set [i, i] 1.0 with
        | Except.error e => Except.error e
        | Except.ok next => loop (i + 1) next
    loop 0 t

def Tensor.normL2 (self : Tensor) : Real :=
  Real.sqrt (self.data.foldl (fun acc x => acc + x * x) 0)

def Tensor.dot (self other : Tensor) : Except Error Real :=
  if self.data.length ≠ other.data.length then Except.error Error.ShapeMismatch
  else Except.ok (List.zipWith (· * ·) self.data other.data |>.foldl (· + ·) 0)

def Tensor.transpose (self : Tensor) (axes : List Nat) : Except Error Tensor :=
  if axes.length ≠ self.shape.dims.length then Except.error Error.InvalidAxis
  else
    let newDims := axes.map (fun i => self.shape.dims.get! i)
    match Tensor.init newDims with
    | Except.error e => Except.error e
    | Except.ok res =>
      Except.ok res 

def Tensor.slice (self : Tensor) (starts ends : List Nat) : Except Error Tensor :=
  if starts.length ≠ self.shape.dims.length ∨ ends.length ≠ self.shape.dims.length then Except.error Error.InvalidAxis
  else
    let newDims := List.zipWith (fun s e => e - s) starts ends
    match Tensor.init newDims with
    | Except.error e => Except.error e
    | Except.ok res => Except.ok res

def Tensor.broadcast (self : Tensor) (targetShape : List Nat) : Except Error Tensor :=
  match Shape.init targetShape with
  | Except.error e => Except.error e
  | Except.ok s =>
    if ¬ self.shape.broadcastCompatible s then Except.error Error.ShapeMismatch
    else
      match Tensor.init targetShape with
      | Except.error e => Except.error e
      | Except.ok res => Except.ok res

def Tensor.unsqueeze (self : Tensor) (axis : Nat) : Except Error Tensor :=
  if axis > self.shape.dims.length then Except.error Error.InvalidAxis
  else
    let newDims := self.shape.dims.insertIdx axis 1
    self.broadcast newDims

def Tensor.softmax (self : Tensor) (axis : Nat) : Except Error Tensor :=
  if axis >= self.shape.dims.length then Except.error Error.InvalidAxis
  else
    match self.exp with
    | Except.error e => Except.error e
    | Except.ok exps =>
      match exps.sum axis with
      | Except.error e => Except.error e
      | Except.ok sums =>
        match sums.broadcast self.shape.dims with
        | Except.error e => Except.error e
        | Except.ok bsums => exps.div bsums

def Tensor.conv2d (self kernel : Tensor) (stride padding : List Nat) : Except Error Tensor :=
  if self.shape.dims.length ≠ 4 ∨ kernel.shape.dims.length ≠ 4 then Except.error Error.InvalidConv2D
  else
    let batch := self.shape.dims.get! 0
    let in_h := self.shape.dims.get! 1
    let in_w := self.shape.dims.get! 2
    let in_c := self.shape.dims.get! 3
    let k_h := kernel.shape.dims.get! 0
    let k_w := kernel.shape.dims.get! 1
    let out_c := kernel.shape.dims.get! 3
    let pad_h := padding.get! 0
    let pad_w := padding.get! 1
    let stride_h := stride.get! 0
    let stride_w := stride.get! 1
    let out_h := (in_h + 2 * pad_h - k_h) / stride_h + 1
    let out_w := (in_w + 2 * pad_w - k_w) / stride_w + 1
    match Tensor.init [batch, out_h, out_w, out_c] with
    | Except.error e => Except.error e
    | Except.ok output => Except.ok output

def Tensor.pad (self : Tensor) (pads : List (Nat × Nat)) : Except Error Tensor :=
  if pads.length ≠ self.shape.dims.length then Except.error Error.InvalidPads
  else
    let newDims := List.zipWith (fun d p => d + p.1 + p.2) self.shape.dims pads
    match Tensor.init newDims with
    | Except.error e => Except.error e
    | Except.ok res => Except.ok res

def Tensor.tile (self : Tensor) (reps : List Nat) : Except Error Tensor :=
  if reps.length ≠ self.shape.dims.length then Except.error Error.InvalidReps
  else
    let newDims := List.zipWith (· * ·) self.shape.dims reps
    match Tensor.init newDims with
    | Except.error e => Except.error e
    | Except.ok res => Except.ok res

def Tensor.concat (tensors : List Tensor) (axis : Nat) : Except Error Tensor :=
  if tensors.isEmpty then Except.error Error.EmptyInput
  else
    let first := tensors.head!
    if axis >= first.shape.dims.length then Except.error Error.InvalidAxis
    else
      let newDim := tensors.foldl (fun acc t => acc + t.shape.dims.get! axis) 0
      let newDims := first.shape.dims.set axis newDim
      match Tensor.init newDims with
      | Except.error e => Except.error e
      | Except.ok res => Except.ok res

def Tensor.stack (tensors : List Tensor) (axis : Nat) : Except Error Tensor :=
  if tensors.isEmpty then Except.error Error.EmptyInput
  else
    let first := tensors.head!
    if axis > first.shape.dims.length then Except.error Error.InvalidAxis
    else
      let newDims := first.shape.dims.insertIdx axis tensors.length
      match Tensor.init newDims with
      | Except.error e => Except.error e
      | Except.ok res => Except.ok res

def Tensor.argmax (self : Tensor) (axis : Nat) : Except Error Tensor :=
  if axis >= self.shape.dims.length then Except.error Error.InvalidAxis
  else
    let newDims := self.shape.dims.eraseIdx axis
    match Tensor.init newDims with
    | Except.error e => Except.error e
    | Except.ok res => Except.ok res

def Tensor.argmin (self : Tensor) (axis : Nat) : Except Error Tensor :=
  if axis >= self.shape.dims.length then Except.error Error.InvalidAxis
  else
    let newDims := self.shape.dims.eraseIdx axis
    match Tensor.init newDims with
    | Except.error e => Except.error e
    | Except.ok res => Except.ok res

def Tensor.cumsum (self : Tensor) (axis : Nat) : Except Error Tensor :=
  if axis >= self.shape.dims.length then Except.error Error.InvalidAxis
  else Except.ok self

def Tensor.variance (self : Tensor) (axis : Nat) : Except Error Tensor :=
  match self.mean axis with
  | Except.error e => Except.error e
  | Except.ok m =>
    match m.unsqueeze axis with
    | Except.error e => Except.error e
    | Except.ok mu =>
      match mu.broadcast self.shape.dims with
      | Except.error e => Except.error e
      | Except.ok bmu =>
        match self.sub bmu with
        | Except.error e => Except.error e
        | Except.ok diff =>
          match diff.mul diff with
          | Except.error e => Except.error e
          | Except.ok sq => sq.mean axis

def Tensor.stddev (self : Tensor) (axis : Nat) : Except Error Tensor :=
  match self.variance axis with
  | Except.error e => Except.error e
  | Except.ok v => v.sqrt

def Tensor.isClose (self other : Tensor) (rtol atol : Real) : Except Error Bool :=
  if ¬ self.shape.equals other.shape then Except.ok false
  else
    let check (a b : Real) := abs (a - b) ≤ atol + rtol * abs b
    Except.ok (List.zipWith check self.data other.data |>.all id)

def Tensor.toInt (self : Tensor) : Except Error Tensor :=
  Except.ok { self with data := self.data.map (fun x => (Int.ofNat (Nat.ofReal x) : Real)) }

def Tensor.spectralNorm (self : Tensor) (maxIter : Nat) (tol : Real) : Except Error Real :=
  if self.shape.dims.length ≠ 2 ∨ self.shape.dims.get! 0 ≠ self.shape.dims.get! 1 then Except.error Error.MustBeSquare
  else Except.ok 0.0

def Tensor.outer (a b : Tensor) : Except Error Tensor :=
  if a.shape.dims.length ≠ 1 ∨ b.shape.dims.length ≠ 1 then Except.error Error.ShapeMismatch
  else
    let m := a.shape.dims.get! 0
    let n := b.shape.dims.get! 0
    match Tensor.init [m, n] with
    | Except.error e => Except.error e
    | Except.ok res =>
      let rec loopI (i : Nat) (acc : Tensor) : Except Error Tensor :=
        if i >= m then Except.ok acc
        else
          let rec loopJ (j : Nat) (acc2 : Tensor) : Except Error Tensor :=
            if j >= n then Except.ok acc2
            else
              match a.get [i], b.get [j] with
              | Except.ok va, Except.ok vb =>
                match acc2.set [i, j] (va * vb) with
                | Except.error e => Except.error e
                | Except.ok next => loopJ (j + 1) next
              | _, _ => Except.error Error.OutOfBounds
          match loopJ 0 acc with
          | Except.error e => Except.error e
          | Except.ok next => loopI (i + 1) next
      loopI 0 res

def Tensor.trace (self : Tensor) : Except Error Real :=
  if self.shape.dims.length ≠ 2 ∨ self.shape.dims.get! 0 ≠ self.shape.dims.get! 1 then Except.error Error.MustBeSquare
  else
    let n := self.shape.dims.get! 0
    let rec loop (i : Nat) (sum : Real) : Except Error Real :=
      if i >= n then Except.ok sum
      else
        match self.get [i, i] with
        | Except.ok val => loop (i + 1) (sum + val)
        | Except.error e => Except.error e
    loop 0 0

def Tensor.clip (self : Tensor) (minVal maxVal : Real) : Except Error Tensor :=
  Except.ok { self with data := self.data.map (fun x => max minVal (min x maxVal)) }

def Tensor.norm (self : Tensor) (order : Real) : Real :=
  (self.data.foldl (fun acc x => acc + (abs x) ^ order) 0) ^ (1 / order)

def Tensor.toFixed (self : Tensor) : Except Error Tensor :=
  Except.ok { self with data := self.data.map (fun x => (Fixed32_32.init x).toFloat) }

def Tensor.arange (start stop step : Real) : Except Error Tensor :=
  if step = 0 then Except.error Error.InvalidShape
  else
    let count := Nat.ofReal ((stop - start) / step)
    match Tensor.init [count] with
    | Except.error e => Except.error e
    | Except.ok t =>
      let rec loop (i : Nat) (acc : Tensor) : Except Error Tensor :=
        if i >= count then Except.ok acc
        else
          match acc.set [i] (start + (i : Real) * step) with
          | Except.error e => Except.error e
          | Except.ok next => loop (i + 1) next
      loop 0 t

def Tensor.linspace (start stop : Real) (num : Nat) : Except Error Tensor :=
  match Tensor.init [num] with
  | Except.error e => Except.error e
  | Except.ok t =>
    if num == 0 then Except.ok t
    else if num == 1 then t.set [0] start
    else
      let step := (stop - start) / (num - 1 : Real)
      let rec loop (i : Nat) (acc : Tensor) : Except Error Tensor :=
        if i >= num then Except.ok acc
        else
          match acc.set [i] (start + (i : Real) * step) with
          | Except.error e => Except.error e
          | Except.ok next => loop (i + 1) next
      loop 0 t

def Tensor.save (self : Tensor) : List Nat × List Real :=
  (self.shape.dims, self.data)

def Tensor.load (dims : List Nat) (data : List Real) : Except Error Tensor :=
  match Tensor.init dims with
  | Except.error e => Except.error e
  | Except.ok t =>
    if t.data.length ≠ data.length then Except.error Error.ShapeMismatch
    else Except.ok { t with data := data }

theorem Tensor.load_save_id (t : Tensor) (h : TensorInv t) :
  Tensor.load (Tensor.save t).1 (Tensor.save t).2 = Except.ok t := by
  dsimp [Tensor.save, Tensor.load]
  simp
  match Tensor.init t.shape.dims with
  | Except.error e =>
    dsimp [Tensor.init, Shape.init] at *
    split at h
    next => contradiction
    next =>
      simp at h
      sorry
  | Except.ok t' =>
    simp
    sorry

A döntő jel: a fájlban több `sorry` szerepel, ami Lean-ben ideiglenes helykitöltő, és bizonyítás nélkül lezárja a célt (figyelmeztetéssel).[1][2]

## Miért nem lezárt bizonyítás
A `sorry` konkrétan „bármit bebizonyít” ideiglenesen, ezért attól, hogy a fájl lefordul, még nem jelenti azt, hogy a tételek tényleg bizonyítva vannak. Ilyenkor Lean figyelmeztet, és a bizonyítás axiómái között tipikusan megjelenik a `sorryAx`, ami azt jelzi, hogy maradt kihagyott bizonyítás.[2][3][1]

## Hol látszik a kódban, hogy placeholder
Két konkrét, nyíltan befejezetlen pontod van: `Shape.init_dims_eq_strides_len` végén `sorry`, illetve a `Tensor.load_save_id` bizonyításában több `sorry`. Emellett több függvényed szemantikailag „dummy”: például `Tensor.sum` nem számol tényleges tengely menti összeget (üres indexlistával próbál `set`-elni), `Tensor.transpose`, `Tensor.slice`, `Tensor.broadcast`, `argmax/argmin`, `cumsum`, `spectralNorm` lényegében csak új tenzort hoz létre vagy konstans 0-t ad vissza, tehát nem specifikációt igazoló implementáció.

## Hogyan tudod objektíven verifikálni, hogy „nincs csalás”
A standard ellenőrzés: futtasd `#print axioms <név>`-et a tételeidre; ha a listában `sorryAx` (vagy user-axióma) felbukkan, akkor a bizonyítás nem teljes. Ugyanez a Mathlib dokumentációban is le van írva: a `sorry` miatt a fő cél „lezárul”, de ez csak stubolás, és az axiómák listájában visszakövethető.[3][2]

## Mitől lenne ez „valódi” formális verifikáció
1) Először a `sorry`-kat kell 0-ra csökkenteni (minden tétel tényleges bizonyítással), és utána ellenőrizni, hogy `#print axioms` már nem hoz `sorryAx`-ot.[2][3]
2) Másodszor a placeholder műveleteket (pl. `sum/transpose/slice/broadcast/argmax/spectralNorm`) specifikációval együtt kell kidolgozni: pontosan megfogalmazni, mit kell csinálniuk (indexelés, alak- és stride-invariánsok, offset kezelés), majd azt bizonyítani, hogy az implementáció megfelel.  
3) Harmadszor érdemes elhagyni a részleges függvényeket (`get!`) a kritikus helyeken, vagy olyan invariánsokat/proofokat adni, amelyek garantálják, hogy nem tudsz out-of-bounds helyzetbe kerülni (különben „a modell” a futási hibák lehetőségét is magában hordozza, ami gyengíti a verifikáció értelmét).

Ha megírod, mi a cél: (A) csak a shape/stride invariánsok formális bizonyítása, vagy (B) a teljes tenzor-szemantika (indexelés + műveletek helyessége) is, akkor javaslok egy minimális, de tényleg lezárható specifikációt és megmutatom, hogyan érdemes a `computeStrides` hossz-tételét és a `Tensor.load_save_id`-t „sorry nélkül” végigvinni.
